notes.claim: To increase or decrease by a percentage, add the percentage to 100% or subtract it from 100%, then find that percentage of the amount.
After a 5% increase the new amount is 105% of the original, and after a 5% decrease it is 95% of the original.
Converting the new percentage to a decimal and multiplying gives the new amount in one step, the decimal multiplier method.
Oak National Academy notes that reading 3% as 0.3 carries into increases, so a 3% rise is wrongly given a multiplier of 1.3.
